corpus_reassessment.interpretation: The overnight 29/39 trigger mixed raw-to-final-land-clipped Hausdorff with source-to-smoothed candidate Hausdorff. D-120 separates those axes. Thirty-three polygons require no policy substitution; existing reviewed renders are reusable after corpus/topology review. Six rows received focused visual/comparative review.

focused_reviews.subject: Achaemenid Persis/Elam royal economy
focused_reviews.visual_review: PASS — candidate retains the source inland/frontier outline while reducing incumbent coastal/component inflation; canonical coastline fit remains exact enough for the hard land gate.

focused_reviews.subject: Achaemenid Persis/Elam royal economy
focused_reviews.visual_review: PASS — same-source v2 candidate preserves the visible inland frontier and materially reduces component inflation without introducing a new territorial interpretation.

focused_reviews.subject: Baekje
focused_reviews.override_reason: The source polygon has only 53 points and places substantial coarse geometry offshore. Visual review shows the large symmetric difference is overwhelmingly coastline/island normalization; the inland/eastern/northern source frontier remains visually stable. No available alternative passes the symmetric-difference gate, and serving raw source geometry would violate the canonical-land contract.
focused_reviews.visual_review: PASS WITH BOUNDED OVERRIDE — retain exact v0.8.1 v3 render; do not treat added coastline detail as historical evidence.

focused_reviews.subject: Mauryan Empire
focused_reviews.visual_review: PASS — v2 is visually equivalent at the historical frontier, lowers policy displacement below the D-120 ceiling and avoids unnecessary incumbent transformation.

focused_reviews.subject: Roman Empire — early Principate
focused_reviews.visual_review: PASS — v3 tracks the same raw frontier while sharply reducing displacement and component inflation; it is also temporally consistent with adjacent 1–5 and 9–13 CE v3 slices.

focused_reviews.subject: Western Han China
focused_reviews.visual_review: PASS — v3 follows the source frontier, lowers displacement below the ceiling and restores temporal-family consistency with adjacent Western Han v3 slices.

successor_geometry_disposition.note: The two Mycenaean geometries are claim-evidence-locus points only and must never render as territorial practice polygons.

release_effect: Authorizes geometry reuse/substitution rules for v0.8.2 authority and serving construction. v0.8.1 remains immutable.
